name: Grupotel Alte Post
beschreibung: The Gasthof Grupotel Alte Post is located in a village in Tirol. The building combines traditional construction with modern facilities. The rooms are functionally furnished and offer views of the surrounding mountains. The restaurant serves regional dishes from Tiroler cuisine. A beer garden is available in the summer months. Hiking trails start directly at the house. The staff provides information about excursion destinations in the surrounding area. The Gasthof serves as a base for activities in nature.
